definitions.turn_efficiency: Revenue generated per scarce unit action/turn; variants reduce recurring actions, travel, replanting, and optional maintenance.
definitions.labor_efficiency: Revenue generated per hired hand-day; variants constrain team size and adapt production to the smaller workforce.

agents.name: ongoing_crop_core
agents.objective: Maximize revenue per unit action by reducing harvest/replant cycles.
agents.changes: Prioritize strawberry/tomato; suppress short-cycle carrot and excess wheat.

agents.name: melon_batch_farming
agents.objective: Concentrate labor into infrequent, high-value batch harvests.
agents.changes: Melon-first portfolio; sharply reduce ongoing and short-cycle crops.

agents.name: wheat_batch_feed
agents.objective: Use simple four-day crop cycles and local feed to reduce market and routing actions.
agents.changes: Wheat-first planting; moderate cow window; sheep disabled.

agents.name: minimal_optional_animal_work
agents.objective: Reserve turns for mandatory feed, crop work, and harvest.
agents.changes: Disable animal care and fertilizer collection; retain v8.3 fleet economics.

agents.name: alternate_care
agents.objective: Capture some care bonus with half the routine care actions.
agents.changes: Care only on even-numbered days; fertilizer collection disabled.

agents.name: production_window_care
agents.objective: Spend care actions selectively rather than every eligible day.
agents.changes: Skip care every third day and skip fertilizer collection.

agents.name: compact_farm
agents.objective: Reduce walking turns by delaying expansion and keeping work near the shed.
agents.changes: Land purchases start day 8 and require an additional $2,000 reserve.

agents.name: small_cow_fleet
agents.objective: Limit daily maintenance actions while retaining premium animal output.
agents.changes: Disable sheep; stop cow purchases after day 12; lower animal labor weighting.

agents.name: no_fertilizer_logistics
agents.objective: Eliminate collect, carry, deposit, and sale actions for a low-priority byproduct.
agents.changes: Fertilizer collection disabled; all other behavior unchanged.

agents.name: crop_only_batch
agents.objective: Avoid all animal setup and daily maintenance actions.
agents.changes: Disable sheep and close cow purchase window; melon/strawberry batch crop mix.

agents.name: six_hand_cap
agents.objective: Maximize farm output per worker by imposing a hard six-hand ceiling.
agents.changes: Hand target 3–6; maximum six hires; expansion gates inherit the cap.

agents.name: eight_hand_cap
agents.objective: Use a moderate worker ceiling while preserving more throughput than the strict cap.
agents.changes: Hand target 3–8; maximum eight hires; seven work units per target hand.

agents.name: ten_hand_cap
agents.objective: Seek a balanced labor frontier between v8.3 throughput and payroll footprint.
agents.changes: Hand target 4–10; maximum ten hires; six work units per target hand.

agents.name: crop_protected_small_team
agents.objective: Make a small team dependable by protecting most workers for crop survival.
agents.changes: Eight-hand cap and protected crop fraction raised to 70–85%.

agents.name: animal_specialist_small_team
agents.objective: Use fewer workers but devote a larger share to high-value animal maintenance.
agents.changes: Eight-hand cap, low crop protection, animal workload counted at weight three.

agents.name: ongoing_crops_eight_hands
agents.objective: Reduce replant burden so each worker supports more occupied tiles.
agents.changes: Eight-hand cap plus strawberry/tomato-heavy ongoing-crop portfolio.

agents.name: melon_eight_hands
agents.objective: Allocate a constrained workforce to a high-value, infrequent-harvest crop.
agents.changes: Eight-hand cap; melon-first portfolio; reduced crop variety.

agents.name: cow_wheat_eight_hands
agents.objective: Use a constrained team on home-fed cows rather than a mixed premium fleet.
agents.changes: Eight-hand cap, sheep disabled, wheat-first portfolio, cows available through day 18.

agents.name: alternate_care_eight_hands
agents.objective: Stretch a limited workforce across animals by halving care cadence.
agents.changes: Eight-hand cap, alternate-day care, no fertilizer collection.

agents.name: four_hand_austerity
agents.objective: Measure the extreme output-per-worker frontier with a four-hand ceiling.
agents.changes: Hand target 2–4, no sheep, no care, no fertilizer collection, delayed land.
